# Project Data Lake & Colab Sync
- **Local Data Directory:** `c:/Users/Admin/Documents/Vibecoding vnstock/data/`
- **Google Drive Synced Cache:** `G:/My Drive/vnstock_data/` (configured via `GOOGLE_DRIVE_DATA_DIR` in `.env`)
- **Colab Cache Files:** `historical_prices.json`, `financial_models.json`, `all_symbols.json`
- Whenever the user runs the Google Colab sync script, updated market files are saved to Google Drive and can be read directly by the backend services.
